about: roofkid/ninfer-4080 (rtx4080-port) serving the GSQ3 .ninfer artifact with the DFlash2 K=7 speculative profile at 131,072 context on rk2v4-e8 KV (the 16 GB card cannot hold 131,072 on rk4v4-e8: planner budget exceeded by 18 MB; rk2v4-e8 halves KV bytes and passes the registry's 128k floor). Host program, no container. Windows needs the 8-file MSVC portability patch from the recipe-kit PR.
source: Windows/MSVC portability patch: local-ai-recipe-kit ninfer-rtx4080 branch, measurements/rtx-4060-ti-16gb/ninfer-windows-msvc.patch
